posts.name: Benhimself
posts.cooked:
Okay, say the Operative is picking a fight with Citizen Dawn, and of course Citizen Truth is in play.

If the Operative uses Kusarigama on Citizen Dawn, does the movement happen before Citizen Truth gets a chance to redirect (and thus possibly taking Dawn out of Citizen Truth's line of sight?) Or would Citizen Truth, redirecting the attack to himself, be the one who gets moved?

If the Operative uses Undivided Attention on Citizen Dawn, does she still get the bonus two attack dice if she initially strikes at Dawn even if Citizen Truth takes the attack?

posts.name: Koga
posts.cooked:
Citizen Truth says to reassign the dice when you roll for the attack so it looks like you'd still get the bonus dice from Undivided Attention as you had already rolled them before reassigning them to Truth.

As for the Kursarigama, it doesn't say to change the target of the attack. Looks like Truth would still reassign the dice to him but Dawn would be the one that gets moved. Not completely sure on this one though.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Truth becomes the defender against the attack, so any effects of the attack would apply to Truth, including picking him up and setting him adjacent to The Operative.

It will work for any other effects of attacks as well.
